# origin kms commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from `origin --help` of the release scripts/origin-cli.version pins (v1.22.2).
     Do not edit by hand: fix the help text in origincloudhq/cli, or scripts/cli_reference_overrides.yml, and rerun. -->

This page lists every `origin kms` command. Keys are regional; for how `--project` and `--region` default, see [Use the CLI](../../platform/access/cli.md#set-a-default-project-zone-and-region). A binary field is read from a file, `--{field}-file PATH`, or `-` for standard input, and bytes in the output are base64. For the API itself, see [KMS reference](index.md).

## origin kms

Key management: encryption and signing keys whose material never leaves the platform, their versions and public keys, and the grants that let a platform host use one. Keys are a project's in a region (`--project`, `--region`), never a zone's: every zone of the region serves them. `encrypt`, `decrypt` and `sign` read their data from a file (`--plaintext-file`, `--ciphertext-file`, `--data-file`; `-` for standard input), byte for byte, and print the API's JSON, whose bytes are base64.

Every `origin kms` command also accepts:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--endpoint <URL>` | Base URL to send the calls to, such as a test server's, instead of the service's own host: `https://kms.origincloudapis.eu`, or `https://kms.{region}.origincloudapis.eu` when the profile names a `region`. It must be `https://`, or `http://` to this machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `[::1]`). Environment variable: `ORIGINCLOUD_KMS_ENDPOINT`. |

### get-grant

Returns a grant that hasn't expired; an expired one is `NOT_FOUND`. A grant made moments ago may be refused with `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, retryable, until its zone's change arrives. Needs `kms.grant.get` on the project.

```sh
origin kms get-grant [OPTIONS] --grant <GRANT>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | no | The key: its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. Needed unless `--grant` is given a whole name, which has it. |
| `--grant <GRANT>` | yes | The grant to return. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region` and `--key`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/grants/{grant}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/grants/{grant}`. |

### list-grants

Lists a key's grants that haven't expired, in every zone, ordered by name. A grant made moments ago may be missing from the list until its zone's change arrives. Needs `kms.grant.list` on the project.

```sh
origin kms list-grants [OPTIONS] --key <KEY>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The key: its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--page-size <PAGE_SIZE>` | no | The most grants to return; the server clamps it, and 0 means its default. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. |
| `--page-token <PAGE_TOKEN>` | no | A previous response's `nextPageToken`, for the page after it. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. |

### create-grant

Makes a grant on an `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key for one host, refused with `BAD_REQUEST` for a key of another purpose, a host that isn't one of the region's, an empty encryption context, or a `--ttl` outside 1 to 60 minutes, and with `CONFLICT` for a key that isn't enabled. Needs `kms.grant.create` on the project.

```sh
origin kms create-grant [OPTIONS] --key <KEY> --operation <OPERATION> --grantee <GRANTEE> --encryption-context <KEY=VALUE> --ttl <DURATION>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The key: its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--operation <OPERATION>` | yes | What the host may do with the key. Possible values: `DECRYPT`. |
| `--grantee <GRANTEE>` | yes | The platform host the grant is for, by the SPIFFE ID its certificate names, which ends in `/zones/{zone}/hosts/{host}`. |
| `--encryption-context <KEY=VALUE>` | yes | The encryption context a use must carry, exactly; never empty. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |
| `--ttl <DURATION>` | yes | How long the grant lives from now: 1 to 60 minutes. Such as `30s` or `1m`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id within a day returns the grant the first request made, instead of making a second. One is generated when not given. |

### renew-grant

Extends a grant that hasn't expired to `--ttl` from now. An expired grant isn't renewed: `CONFLICT`, and a new one is made instead. Needs `kms.grant.update` on the project.

```sh
origin kms renew-grant [OPTIONS] --grant <GRANT> --ttl <DURATION>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | no | The key: its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. Needed unless `--grant` is given a whole name, which has it. |
| `--grant <GRANT>` | yes | The grant to renew. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region` and `--key`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/grants/{grant}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/grants/{grant}`. |
| `--ttl <DURATION>` | yes | How long the grant lives from now: 1 to 60 minutes. Such as `30s` or `1m`. |

### delete-grant

Ends a grant before it expires: from then on it opens nothing. Needs `kms.grant.delete` on the project.

```sh
origin kms delete-grant [OPTIONS] --grant <GRANT>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | no | The key: its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. Needed unless `--grant` is given a whole name, which has it. |
| `--grant <GRANT>` | yes | The grant to end. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region` and `--key`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/grants/{grant}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/grants/{grant}`. |
| `--yes` | no | Confirm an irreversible operation: a delete, or a change the help says can't be undone. Without it the command refuses, and says what it would have done, before sending anything. |

### get-key

Returns a key, deleted or not. Needs `kms.key.get` on the project.

```sh
origin kms get-key [OPTIONS] --key <KEY>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The key to return. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |

### list-keys

Lists a project's keys in a region, ordered by name. Deleted ones are listed only when `--show-deleted` is set, so a page may hold fewer keys than `--page-size` and still be followed by another. Needs `kms.key.list` on the project.

```sh
origin kms list-keys [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--page-size <PAGE_SIZE>` | no | The most keys to return; the server clamps it, and 0 means its default. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. |
| `--page-token <PAGE_TOKEN>` | no | A previous response's `nextPageToken`, for the page after it. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. |
| `--show-deleted <true|false>` | no | Whether deleted keys are listed too. Possible values: `true`, `false`. |

### create-key

Creates a key, `ENABLED`, with its first version as the primary. The platform assigns its id, which its `name` returns; an id is never used again. Needs `kms.key.create` on the project.

```sh
origin kms create-key [OPTIONS] --purpose <PURPOSE>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--purpose <PURPOSE>` | yes | What the key is for. Possible values: `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT`, `SIGN_ECDSA_P256_SHA256`, `SIGN_ED25519`. |
| `--state <STATE>` | no | Whether the key can be used. A new key is `ENABLED`; UpdateKey sets it to `ENABLED` or `DISABLED`, and DeleteKey makes it `DELETED`. Possible values: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`, `DELETED`. |
| `--tag <KEY=VALUE>` | no | Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id within a day returns the key the first request created, as it was then, instead of creating a second one. One is generated when not given. |

### update-key

Enables or disables a key, or changes its tags: `--state` and `--tag` are the fields it changes. A disabled key refuses every operation but GetPublicKey with `CONFLICT` until it is enabled again. Setting the state or the tags the key has already succeeds and changes nothing. A deleted key can't be changed: undelete it first. A key the platform manages (`platformManaged`) is refused with `FORBIDDEN`, even when the request would change nothing. Needs `kms.key.update` on the project.

```sh
origin kms update-key [OPTIONS] --key <KEY> <--state <STATE>|--tag <KEY=VALUE>|--no-tags>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The key to change. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--state <STATE>` | one of `--state`, `--tag`, `--no-tags` | Whether the key can be used. A new key is `ENABLED`; UpdateKey sets it to `ENABLED` or `DISABLED`, and DeleteKey makes it `DELETED`. Left as it is when not given. Possible values: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`, `DELETED`. |
| `--tag <KEY=VALUE>` | one of `--state`, `--tag`, `--no-tags` | Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. Replaces all of them, so give every one to keep; `--no-tags` removes them all. Left as they are when neither is given. |
| `--no-tags` | one of `--state`, `--tag`, `--no-tags` | Remove all of its tags. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id within a day returns the key as the first request left it, instead of changing it again. One is generated when not given. |

### delete-key

Deletes a key: it becomes `DELETED` at once, refuses every operation but GetPublicKey, and its material is destroyed at `purgeTime`, after `--destroy-delay`. Until then UndeleteKey restores it, disabled. After it, nothing it encrypted can ever be decrypted again. Deleting a deleted key succeeds and changes nothing. A key the platform manages is refused with `FORBIDDEN`, deleted or not. Needs `kms.key.delete` on the project.

```sh
origin kms delete-key [OPTIONS] --key <KEY>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The key to delete. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--destroy-delay <DURATION>` | no | How long until the key's material is destroyed: whole days, from 1 to 90; 30 days when unset. Such as `30s` or `1m`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id within a day returns the key as the first request left it. One is generated when not given. |
| `--yes` | no | Confirm an irreversible operation: a delete, or a change the help says can't be undone. Without it the command refuses, and says what it would have done, before sending anything. |

### undelete-key

Restores a deleted key whose material isn't destroyed yet: it becomes `DISABLED`, to be enabled with UpdateKey. Refused with `CONFLICT` for a key that isn't deleted, or whose `purgeTime` has passed, and with `FORBIDDEN` for a key the platform manages. Needs `kms.key.delete` on the project.

```sh
origin kms undelete-key [OPTIONS] --key <KEY>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The deleted key to restore. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id within a day returns the key as the first request left it, instead of answering `CONFLICT`. One is generated when not given. |

### rotate-key

Adds a new version to a key and makes it the primary: new ciphertexts and signatures use it, and every earlier version still decrypts and its public key stays readable. Refused with `CONFLICT` for a key that isn't enabled, and with `FORBIDDEN` for a key the platform manages. Needs `kms.key.rotate` on the project.

```sh
origin kms rotate-key [OPTIONS] --key <KEY>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The key to rotate. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id within a day returns the key as the first request left it, instead of adding another version. One is generated when not given. |

### encrypt

Encrypts up to 64 KiB with an `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key's primary version, bound to the encryption context. For more data, encrypt it yourself with a data key from GenerateDataKey. Refused with `CONFLICT` for a key that isn't enabled, and with `BAD_REQUEST` for a signing key. Needs `kms.key.encrypt` on the project.

```sh
origin kms encrypt [OPTIONS] --key <KEY> --plaintext-file <PATH>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key to encrypt with. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--plaintext-file <PATH>` | yes | The data to encrypt, at most 64 KiB. Read from the file at the path, or from standard input with `-`, byte for byte. |
| `--encryption-context <KEY=VALUE>` | no | Pairs bound into the ciphertext, which Decrypt must be given again, exactly. They aren't secret: the audit log records them. At most 16 pairs, each key and value 1 to 256 bytes. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |

### decrypt

Decrypts a ciphertext Encrypt or GenerateDataKey made with this key, given the same encryption context. Refused with `BAD_REQUEST` for a ciphertext that doesn't decrypt under this key and context, and with `CONFLICT` for a key that isn't enabled. Needs `kms.key.decrypt` on the project.

```sh
origin kms decrypt [OPTIONS] --key <KEY> --ciphertext-file <PATH>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The key the ciphertext was made with. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--ciphertext-file <PATH>` | yes | What Encrypt or GenerateDataKey returned as `--ciphertext-file`. Read from the file at the path, or from standard input with `-`, byte for byte. |
| `--encryption-context <KEY=VALUE>` | no | The encryption context the ciphertext was made with. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |

### generate-data-key

Returns a new random 256-bit data key, in plaintext and encrypted under an `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key's primary version with the encryption context. Encrypt your data with the plaintext, keep only the ciphertext beside it, and recover the data key with Decrypt when you need it. Needs `kms.key.generate_data_key` on the project.

```sh
origin kms generate-data-key [OPTIONS] --key <KEY>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key to encrypt the data key with. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--encryption-context <KEY=VALUE>` | no | Pairs bound into the data key's ciphertext, as Encrypt's. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |

### sign

Signs up to 64 KiB with a signing key's primary version, or the version `--key-version` names. ECDSA hashes the data with SHA-256 itself: send the data, not a digest. Refused with `CONFLICT` for a key that isn't enabled, and with `BAD_REQUEST` for an `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key. Needs `kms.key.sign` on the project.

```sh
origin kms sign [OPTIONS] --key <KEY> --data-file <PATH>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | yes | The signing key to sign with. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. |
| `--data-file <PATH>` | yes | The data to sign, at most 64 KiB. Read from the file at the path, or from standard input with `-`, byte for byte. |
| `--key-version <KEY_VERSION>` | no | The full name of the version of `--key` to sign with, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/{name}/versions/{version}`. Without it, the key's primary version signs. Name it when the signature's verifiers must know the version before the signature exists, for example a token whose header names its key: the primary can change between reading it and signing. Refused with `BAD_REQUEST` for a version of another key or a destroyed version. |

### get-public-key

Returns a signing key version's public key, to verify its signatures with. Answered for a disabled or deleted key too, until its material is destroyed. Refused with `BAD_REQUEST` for an `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key. Needs `kms.key.get_public_key` on the project.

```sh
origin kms get-public-key [OPTIONS] --version <VERSION>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--region <REGION>` | no | The region, such as `eu-central1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_REGION`, else the profile's `region`, else the region of the default zone (`ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE` or `default-zone`), when not given. |
| `--key <KEY>` | no | The key: its id, completed with `--project` and `--region`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. Needed unless `--version` is given a whole name, which has it. |
| `--version <VERSION>` | yes | The public key to return: a key version's name followed by `/publicKey`. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--region` and `--key`, or its full name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/versions/{version}/publicKey`, or its relative name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/versions/{version}/publicKey`. |
